description: A gathering place for Leichty family history, photographs, stories, and reunions.

reunion.label: Rounding Up the Leichty Clan · Leichty Family Reunion
reunion.location: Shanklin Park Indoor Pavilion, Goshen, Indiana
reunion.tagline: Celebrating seven generations of heritage, storytelling, and family connection.
reunion.registration: Formal invitation and RSVP details will follow

schedule.detail: Welcome, name tags, sign-in, and getting settled.
All-family group portrait gathered together before lunch.
Buffet service, blessing, and open family table seating.
Shared memories, family history, and elder spotlights.
Yard & board games, memory sharing, photo browsing & visiting.
Game winners announced, awards, and closing remarks.
Warm goodbyes and safe travels. Cleanup begins afterward.

highlights.title: Memory Tables
highlights.detail: Explore historic family photos, branch lineage trees, and heirloom keepsakes.

highlights.title: Yard & Table Games
highlights.detail: Friendly competition with cornhole, giant Jenga, board games, and trivia.

highlights.title: Family Guestbook
highlights.detail: Leave a personal note, favorite family recipe, or memory for our archives.

whatToBring.title: Family Memorabilia
whatToBring.detail: Old photos, albums, scrapbooks, or heirlooms to display on the shared Memory Table.

whatToBring.title: Comfortable Attire
whatToBring.detail: We will have both indoor pavilion seating and lawn space for games outside.

whatToBring.title: Your Favorite Memories
whatToBring.detail: Think of a story or favorite memory of Grandpa John, Grandma Salome, or growing up in the family to share during our storytelling hour.

reminders.title: Family Photo at 12:00 PM
reminders.detail: Please be in the main pavilion hall so everyone is in the picture!

reminders.title: Hospitality
reminders.detail: Refreshments, coffee, and water are available throughout the afternoon.

reminders.title: Questions & Contact
reminders.detail: Reach out to Philip Leichty with any questions about the day.

primary.detail: The closest airport with regular commercial flights, approximately 30–40 miles from Goshen. This is probably the easiest airport for most family members flying in.

airports.tip: Check flight prices and schedules for SBN first, but it may be worth comparing the other airports for better fares or nonstop flights.

restaurants.intro: There are lots of great places to eat in and around Goshen! Here are some recommendations for the reunion weekend:

goshen.name: Venturi
goshen.detail: Award-winning, authentic Neapolitan pizza in downtown Goshen. A great choice for dinner.

goshen.name: The Table at 108
goshen.detail: Italian-inspired food in a comfortable, family-friendly setting.

goshen.name: Hoppers Pike Street Grill
goshen.detail: Casual American dining with generous portions.

goshen.name: Biebs & Ash
goshen.detail: Burgers, sandwiches and fries in downtown Goshen.

goshen.name: Universal Tamal
goshen.detail: Great choice for Mexican food and homemade tamales.

goshen.name: Maple Indian Cuisine
goshen.detail: A flavorful option for Indian food.

breakfast.name: The Tipsy Biscuit
breakfast.detail: Popular spot for breakfast and brunch.

breakfast.name: Olympia Candy Kitchen
breakfast.detail: A historic downtown favorite for breakfast, lunch and homemade candy.

breakfast.name: South Side Soda Shop
breakfast.detail: A fun, old-fashioned diner and soda fountain.

amish.name: Blue Gate Restaurant & Bakery
amish.detail: In Shipshewana. A great place to experience classic Amish-country cooking and homemade bakery treats.

amish.name: Das Dutchman Essenhaus
amish.detail: In Middlebury. Family-style Amish cooking, homemade noodles, chicken and delicious pies.

restaurants.tip: Check Google for current hours, menus, reviews and directions before visiting, as hours can change.
